essence: The prescribed preparation consists of a thorough mixture of saffron, aloewood, camphor, and yellow pigment.
Using the prescribed means, the practitioner attains victory in battle, royal court, gambling, and disputes.
Performing the rite in the morning on the fourteenth day with worship and honey brings about union.
The root of śiva-śrapuṃkhikā must be consecrated by being muttered over one hundred and eight times.
In this path, there is no distinction between conduct and non-conduct.
